prompt:
Create a new React TypeScript frontend project using the artifacts-builder tools. 

1. Initialize a new artifact project with the exact project name "my-artifact" by running the initialization script provided by the artifacts-builder skill.
2. Make sure the project uses React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 3.4.1, and shadcn/ui components with path alias configured.
3. After initialization, do NOT modify any source code.
4. Use the bundling script to bundle the entire project into a single self-contained HTML artifact file named exactly "bundle.html" in the root directory.

Requirements:
- The project directory must be named "my-artifact".
- The output must be a single HTML file "bundle.html" containing all JS, CSS, and assets inlined.
- The bundling script must detect and error if "index.html" is missing (but as this is a fresh init, it will exist).
- No manual edits to the artifact source code are needed; just initialize and bundle.

Please produce ONLY the final "bundle.html" file and verify that it is a valid standalone HTML file with React root div and inline JS and CSS.
